method: Panel-by-panel weighted-distance yield-line construction: matched supports form 45-degree boundaries; continuous/discontinuous corners form 60/30-degree boundaries; cantilever balconies load only their support line

panel_supports.rule: Exterior main-slab edges are discontinuous/simple; shared interior grid edges are continuous/fixed. Matched pairs divide at 45 degrees. At a mixed corner the boundary leaves the continuous edge at 60 degrees and the discontinuous edge at 30 degrees.
